title: Hop limit clamping prevents flood amplification attacks
description:
Location: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs lines 372-375

What is good: RREQ parsing clamps hop_limit to MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15):
    let hop_limit = data[1].min(MAX_HOP_LIMIT);

This prevents attackers from sending RREQ with hop_limit=255 to cause network-wide flooding beyond the intended expanding ring limits [4, 8, 15]. The SECURITY comment explains the rationale clearly.

Worth defending if someone suggests removing the clamp for protocol purity.
